description: Work out net (take-home) salary in Saudi Arabia after GOSI, plus the total monthly and yearly cost to the employer (including the expat levy for non-Saudis). Web version: https://irfanaslam.io/tools/saudi-salary-calculator

first_registered.description: When the employee was first registered with GOSI. Default before_2024_07_03.

housing_in_kind.description: True if the employer provides housing instead of an allowance (counts as 2 months' basic a year).

other_deductions.description: Other monthly deductions such as absence or loan (SAR).
